expect: The tablet uses its location only to find Wi-Fi networks nearby.

evaluate: Capacitor.Plugins.ElizaWiFi.getConnectivity().then(({ ssid }) => { const lines = document.body.innerText.split('\n').map(line => line.trim()).filter(Boolean); return typeof ssid === 'string' && lines.some((line, i) => line === ssid && lines[i + 1] === 'Connected'); })
